messages:
maya: Quick follow-up on the recent KV memory/OOM spiral. Thread to collect owners, short-term mitigations, and an experiment schedule.

maya: Summary: small steady residency growth + increasing fragmentation over multi-day uptimes. Pattern surfaces when lightweight long-lived prefixes accumulate. Need profiling -> soft limits -> compaction experiments.

sam: ack. I'll own deep-profiling and the allocation diffs. Will try to capture two long-run heap profiles and a cumulative allocation timeline.

devon: I'll run eviction/GC trials. Plan: try conservative soft cap first, then daily compaction job, then experiment with fragmentation-aware allocator prototypes.

jordan: I'll handle canary traffic routing and create a dashboard slice for memory residency, frag_ratio, and eviction_count. Also add a paging rule if frag_ratio > 0.75 for 15m.

lina: I'll re-run the workload replay to reproduce the ~10-18 hour drift. Need the prod trace export and the model config. @sam please share the S3 path.

sam: shared path: s3://redwood-prod-exports/kv-traces/2026-03-30/trace_v3.tar.gz. Also dropped a small repro command in eng-runtime/repro/run_local_replay.sh.

devon: Experiment plan (short list):
- short: soft cap max_residency_bytes=8GB + progressive throttling (log + counter)
- short: eviction aggressiveness + decrease hot residency window
- medium: nightly slab compaction job at 03:00 PT
- long: prototype fragmentation-aware allocator for hot-slab path

maya: Tentative owners & timelines (please confirm by EOD):
- Profiling artifacts & allocation diff: sam -> 2026-04-06
- Replay + repro verification: lina -> 2026-04-05
- Canary eviction rollout + dashboard: jordan -> 2026-04-07
- Eviction + compaction experiments: devon -> 2026-04-09
- Consolidated eval + next steps doc: maya -> 2026-04-12

jordan: Will add dashboard widgets: p50/p95 memory, frag_ratio, eviction/sec. Alert: frag_ratio > 0.75 for 15m -> page. Also will route 10% traffic to canary group.

lina: Replay run finished. Reproduced slow drift at ~13h uptime on trace_v3. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-results/replays/3467890123/. Noted the drift aligns with long prefix churn.

sam: pprof excerpt from a capture run: ```heap profile: 60s, 412MB total
1: 210MB  (hot slab allocations, likely fragmented)
2: 120MB  (prefix index nodes)
3: 82MB   (KV metadata structures)
``` Added alloc-diff gist: gists/allocs-3467890123.txt

devon: Question: prefer soft cap + counters or immediate hard eviction? I advocate soft cap + progressive throttles and metrics; will only hard-evict if canary shows no functional regression.

maya: soft cap + progressive throttle is approved. Add prometheus metrics for throttle_count and throttle_latency.

ops-bot: Deploy started by jordan on cluster/kv-canary (build 2026.03.31-0930). Logs: https://deploys.redwood/3467

jordan: Canary is live. Routing ~10% traffic. Initial 4h look: mem residency stable, frag_ratio unchanged. Will keep monitoring for 24h.

devon: Kicking off experiment-1 on a small nodepool with max_residency_bytes=8GB. Collecting heap histograms every 30m.

sam: Found a leak-emulating path in local repro when sequence length > 6k. Dropped a minimal repro and an allocation trace into the gist. Will summarize possible fix options in the eval doc.

lina: Replay infra had a small timeout issue; patched job config and re-ran. No other infra blockers.

maya: Next sync: Wednesday 2026-04-08 09:00 PT to go over early experiment telemetry and decide on compaction job timing.

devon: If eviction causes unexpected latency regressions, will revert and open a hotfix rollback. Plan to run a brief latency/quality A/B during the canary.

jordan: Added runbook checklist to ops playbook under KV OOM -> "frag + residency". Steps: 1) check frag_ratio 2) check eviction_count 3) increase soft cap 4) schedule compaction.

maya: Blockers?

sam: Need a larger repro VM for long pprof runs. Pinged infra for a 64GB VM.

maya: Great. Keep incremental notes here. Update the task board when you claim items. :thumbsup:
